title: Internal: handling procedure for archiving an exhausted or expired class-credit pack
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states the entry point for administratively archiving a class-credit pack once it has become exhausted or expired, and for the reference value recorded when that happens.

## Applicable situation
Whenever an exhausted or expired class-credit pack is administratively archived to closed status, the system records, for the member's own records, a per-credit dollar reference value implied by the pack's tier. This reference value carries no cash payment of its own; the archival action itself pays out no cash amount.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): archive_class_pack_28917162.

## Parameters
- class_pass_id: the reference number of the exhausted or expired class-credit pack being archived.
- reference_credit_value_usd: the reconciled per-credit dollar reference value being recorded for this archival, in USD, rounded to exactly two decimal places, always zero or a positive amount.

## Return
On success, archive_class_pack_28917162 returns a confirmation naming the pack now closed, the date it was closed, and echoing the reference_credit_value_usd recorded for the member's records. No cash amount is paid out by this action, and no error or review behavior beyond this confirmation is defined for it.
